patthana18.20:1.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana18.20:2.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi… hetuyā cattāri.
patthana18.20:3.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto nasāsavo nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
